name: l2_scn_0601_the_succession_vacuum_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0601 (The Succession Vacuum) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. A ruler dies (or legitimacy collapses) and multiple claimants mobilize. The fight is as much about narrative and alliances as it is about force. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.
